summary: Construct an empty WeakMap using runtime-managed weak-key storage.
caveats: Weak collections are not enumerable and expose no size because observing liveness would expose garbage-collection behavior.
CanBeHeldWeakly accepts Objects and non-registered Symbols; ordinary primitives and registered Symbols are rejected for insertion.

tests.name: constructs
tests.input: const w=new WeakMap(); console.log(w instanceof WeakMap);
